meta.name: Stars and Vows: Anele & Buzza
meta.description: Follow media darling Anele Mdoda and her royal fiance Buzza James from pre-wedding celebrations and tense family moments to their long-awaited "I do."

videos.title: A Wedding Is Not A Family Reunion
videos.overview: As Anele Mdoda and Buzza James kick off their wedding celebrations in Kenya, family tensions loom back home and a jaw-dropping venue raises alarm bells.

videos.title: A Royal, Rebellious Mess
videos.overview: A lavish bridal shower, a lackluster bachelor party and a soaring budget pile on the pressure as Anele and Buzza's wedding draws closer.

videos.title: I Want My Dome
videos.overview: No dome, no plan B and two days until "I do." As Anele, Buzza and the wedding party descend on Stellenbosch, can their dream venue come together in time?

videos.title: Let Them Eat Cake
videos.overview: Anele and Buzza's celebrations culminate at his ancestral home, where family and royal traditions usher the glowing newlyweds into a bright new chapter.
